title: Hope Speech Detection on Social Media Platforms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text classification models (e.g., BERT, SVM, Logistic Regression) on their ability to identify and categorize YouTube comments related to women in STEM as Hope, Non-Hope, or Neutral speech.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to identify and categorize YouTube comments regarding the LGBTQ community as Hope, Non-Hope, or Neutral speech.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to identify and categorize YouTube comments related to Black Lives Matter and racial minorities as Hope, Non-Hope, or Neutral speech.

Evaluating text classification models on their ability to identify and categorize YouTube comments containing nationally motivated slurs or discussing geopolitical topics (e.g., UK/USA/Australia versus China) as Hope, Non-Hope, or Neutral speech.
